method: Horizontal triangle-plane intersection on the committed anatomical body mesh; connected central torso loop selected by topology. Circumferences are mesh-geometric calibration values, not anthropometric ground truth.

intended_geometry_model.interpolation: piecewise smooth positive radial x/z scaling through hip, waist and bust anchors; preserve y before global height scale
intended_geometry_model.validation_requirement: After runtime implementation, measure deformed body geometry from actual generated vertices at every anchor and boundary combination; render and inspect before treating sliders as geometric controls.

limitations: Anchor locations are engineering landmarks selected from this fixture's mesh geometry, not measured anatomical landmarks on a customer.
No pressure, comfort, garment-fit or body-reconstruction accuracy is implied.
Extreme UI combinations require rendered/self-intersection review before approval.
